title: US v. Google ad-tech — parties' deadline to file one jointly proposed Final Judgment (E.D. Va.)
source: NEWS: ppc.land, 'DOJ loses AdX divestiture bid as Brinkema accepts behavioral remedies' (fetched direct 2026-09-08), quoting Judge Leonie M. Brinkema's 2026-09-02 remedies order verbatim on its two deadlines — 14 days (2026-09-16) to move for redactions to the sealed Memorandum Opinion, 30 days (2026-10-02) for the parties to file one jointly proposed Final Judgment. The 2026-09-02 ruling itself is independently corroborated by TechCrunch ('Google spared from ad-business breakup…', fetched direct 2026-09-08), which reports the same holding and the same 14-day sealing period but names no 30-day deadline. The underlying order is a docket entry in United States et al v. Google LLC, No. 1:23-cv-00108 (E.D. Va.), never fetched. Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix table in market-events-data.ts defines NO confirmed prefix for a federal court docket (the same schema gap ftc-v-amazon-antitrust-trial-2027-03-29 documented), this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the 30-day date rests on one source. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: The operative document of the ad-tech case: Brinkema rejected all three structural remedies on 2026-09-02 (AdX divestiture, open-sourcing DFP's final auction logic, contingent DFP Remainder divestiture) and accepted most behavioral remedies as modified, but the reasoning sits UNDER SEAL, so what Google actually has to do is not public until the opinion unseals and this joint judgment is filed. That is why the filing deadline earns a calendar row while the ruling day no longer needs one: the ruling resolved the direction, this document resolves the terms. Tiered `medium`, not `high`, on a measured reaction rather than a guess — the ruling itself, the largest single de-risking available to this name, moved GOOG only +0.53% on 09-02 and +1.59% on 09-03 against QQQ +0.23%/+1.19%, a two-session EXCESS of just +0.71%, while META ran +5.55% over the same two sessions on unrelated tape. The overhang was substantially priced, so the residual document should be smaller still. It matters to this calendar for one structural reason: 2026-10-02 sits INSIDE the goog-2026-10-28-print D-20 run-up window, two sessions after the D-20 entry close (2026-09-30, counted in sessions), so the one researched pre-print long on the roster would be open across it. Two related items are deliberately NOT filed, so their absence reads as a decision: the 2026-09-16 redaction-motion deadline is proposed separately as google-adtech-opinion-unseal-2026-09-16 because its informative branch is conditional, and the DOJ's cross-appeal of Mehta's SEARCH-case remedy to the D.C. Circuit (argument expected 'late 2026 or early 2027') has no date at all and stays in the goog ledger's undated watch list. Discovered during the goog-2026-10-28-print pulse check, 2026-09-08 (adjacency sweep item 4, policy/legal).
